children: Reckitt flagged interest from potential buyers for Mead Johnson, which should be seen as a positive, according to analysts. At the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference, management highlighted incoming calls from a broad range of potential buyers despite the company not running a formal process, according to Barclays analysts. Management was also confident on the quality of the asset, the analysts say. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
